The O3 framework lazy-loads at two levels, and both are lazy by design.

1. **Component level: `getAsyncLifecycle`.** It takes a function that returns a dynamic import (`() => import('./root.component')`). It returns a lifecycle factory, so the component module is fetched only when the lifecycle is invoked. The docs call this "the recommended way to define lifecycles for most modules." `getSyncLifecycle` is the non-lazy counterpart, and `getAsyncExtensionLifecycle` is a deprecated alias for `getAsyncLifecycle`.

2. **App level: `importDynamic` and the routes loader.** `importDynamic(appName)` loads a whole federated app module by package name. It waits on `preloadImport`, then reads the federated container from `window[slug]`, with a 10-minute default timeout. `loadLifeCycles` in esm-routes calls `importDynamic(appName)`, runs the app's `startupApp()`, and then calls the named export (`module[componentName]()`). Pages and extensions/modals from `routes.json` are wired to it through their `load` callbacks.

Examples of apps exporting lazy lifecycles are `esm-login-app/src/index.ts` (lines 28–30), `esm-help-menu-app/src/index.ts` (line 13), `esm-devtools-app/src/index.ts` (line 10), and `esm-primary-navigation-app/src/index.ts` (line 68). I did not read `preloadImport` itself, so the exact federation mechanics there are unverified.

**Documentation:** `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/getAsyncLifecycle.md`, `docs/functions/importDynamic.md`, `docs/functions/getSyncLifecycle.md`, and `docs/API.md` (lines 129 and 237).

**Implementation:** `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/getLifecycle.ts` (lines 52–57), `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-dynamic-loading/src/dynamic-loading.ts` (lines 37–44), and `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-routes/src/loaders/load-lifecycles.ts` (lines 35–58).

Callers of `loadLifeCycles` are `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-routes/src/loaders/pages.ts` (line 238) and `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-routes/src/loaders/components.ts` (lines 58 and 102).
